fields.name: sumit kumar
fields.subject: Issue with Job Application Status
fields.message:
Hello Team,

I recently applied for multiple job positions through the platform. However, I am facing an issue where the application status is not updating properly even after some time.

I would like to know if there is any delay in processing or if there is a technical issue from the backend.

Kindly look into this matter and provide an update.

Thank you,
Sumit Kumar
fields.admin_reply:
Hello Sumit Kumar,

Thank you for reaching out to us.

We understand your concern regarding the delay in the update of your job application status. Our team has reviewed the issue, and it appears that there was a temporary delay in syncing application updates across the system.

Please be assured that your applications are being processed, and the status will be updated shortly. We are actively working to improve the system to avoid such delays in the future.

If the issue persists for more than 24 hours, kindly let us know, and we will investigate it further on priority.

We appreciate your patience and thank you for using CareerNest Hub.

Best regards,
Admin Team
CareerNest Hub
